season_long_player_features.breakout_policy: Until historical breakout-cohort similarity is validated out of sample, the engine may emit WATCH or NO_CALL but may not manufacture BREAKOUT_CANDIDATE or SLEEPER from arbitrary thresholds, ADP, one camp report, or unvalidated narrative.
season_long_player_features.bust_policy: Football-risk context is surfaced independently. Existing downstream OVERPRICED/AVOID draft-side states may be preserved as current market/draft context, but they may not be reverse-engineered into the football projection or Better Player logic. A new BUST_CANDIDATE label requires validated downside-cohort evidence and is not fabricated here.

football_value.reason: Weights were deferred from Step 3B and have not been empirically validated; Step 3G exposes components without inventing coefficients.

completion_rule: A feature engine is implemented when it deterministically consumes its declared prerequisites, emits only contract-allowed labels, and fails safely when prerequisites are missing. Lack of live Week 1 data is a data-state limitation, not permission to fabricate a call.
